## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Broad sector participation (10/11 positive) and leadership shifting into Utilities/Consumer Discretionary/Healthcare while several mega-cap Tech names show 1W weakness, consistent with money rotating.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare also up: MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials lagging: DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND. Industrials showing strain: DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples mixed with standout weakness: WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors represented in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SBUX (1W: -3.47% | 1M: +4.19%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION, UBER (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -3.86%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, NEE (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.00%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select mega-caps and pockets of Industrials/Utilities.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence among large caps (GOOGL, NVDA, INTU showing 1W declines vs 1M gains or deeper losses) — treat as tactical, not confirmation for broad regime change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed / rotating: AAPL (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +13.05%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Technology advancing but leadership uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?
Internal rotation with pockets of strength: JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Financials positive (1W: +1.91%) — supports rotation into cyclicals/value.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Healthcare positive and acting as a defensive/cyclical hybrid in this rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to names showing participation in the rotation (QCOM, F, MRK, LLY) and maintain select Tech winners (AMD, IBM); reduce exposure to structurally weak names and those showing sustained 1W/1M downside (INTU, WMT, DOW). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective and emphasize stocks confirming with news-driven catalysts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through or capitulation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +5.17%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: +3.77%) given leadership in top performers. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -0.19%) and pockets of Industrials where DE and DOW are BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for a 1W follow-through to resolve CORRECTION vs further distribution; QCOM needs sustained 1M strength to confirm breakout and leadership; AAPL holding 1M uptrend keeps Technology participation intact; INTU failure to stabilize keeps it BELOW TREND and a risk to Tech sentiment.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
IBM (+65): IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirming accumulation. QCOM (+55): QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND — deal-driven catalyst confirmed by strong price action. LLY (+65): LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND — Phase 3 news confirmed by price. MRK (+65): MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND — trial news confirming move.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (-50): INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both negative. WMT (-50): WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND — downgrade-driven sell-off confirmed. BA (-45): BA (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines aligning with weakness. TTWO (-45): TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION — sentiment bearish and short-term correction vs 1M strength.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth strong (10/11 sectors positive) and money is rotating into Utilities, Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare. QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, and LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergence (GOOGL, NVDA, INTU showing 1W weakness despite 1M strength or deeper losses) and sentiment-driven moves that warrant tactical monitoring.
